prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW transparent PNG four-direction movement sprite sheet for the EXACT robot in reference image. The reference is character identity and pixel-art style, NOT layout. Square image, exactly 2 columns x 2 rows, four equally sized cells, wide transparent gutters. All robot bodies have identical dimensions, centered at cell (50%,52%) and hover-thruster baseline 85%. Body about 46% of cell width. Hard square pixel clusters, dark teal outlines, cream shell #f0e4bb, teal #35665b, mint eyes/thruster #8fc7a3, brass antenna, top-left lighting, NO gradients, no blur, no text, no floor, no shadows.
Top-left: robot FRONT, faceplate facing viewer with two square eyes, arms lowered.
Top-right: robot LEFT PROFILE, nose/faceplate points toward screen LEFT, exact 90 degree yaw relative to front, only thin edge of front dark faceplate visible at left, circular side shoulder at middle, cream body side dominates. Arms tucked down, no tools.
Bottom-left: robot BACK, exact 180 degree yaw, NO EYES and NO FACEPLATE, cream back with small dark teal vent and two mint status pixels, antenna same, side arms and bottom thruster.
Bottom-right: robot RIGHT PROFILE, faceplate points toward screen RIGHT, exact 90 degree yaw relative to front, thin faceplate edge at right, circular side shoulder at middle, cream body side dominates. Arms tucked down.
This is turning around the upright vertical axis, NOT spinning the picture in the image plane. Each robot upright in ALL views. Same shell, antenna, body size, arm design and thruster as reference. No crops, baskets, cargo, water or seeds; all objects composited separately. All sprites complete with generous 15% transparent padding, never cross cell boundaries.
